note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, 'Main menu', 'Donate', 'Create account', 'Log in'
Table of contents -- renders: 'Contents', 'Unpin', and section headings (e.g., 'Background', 'Terminology') which are operator-defined article structure
Page title bar -- renders: article title 'HTTP cookie' and language selector
Right navigation tabs and tools -- renders: 'Read', 'View source', 'View history', 'Tools'
Site subtitle -- renders: 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'

Footer -- renders: copyright notices, 'Privacy policy', 'About Wikipedia', 'Disclaimers', 'Contact Wikipedia', 'Legal & safety contacts', 'Code of Conduct', 'Developers', 'Statistics', 'Cookie statement', 'Mobile view'
